## Problem and behavior

Explain the concrete problem and resulting behavior. Link an issue when useful.

## Verification

List the relevant commands and outcomes. Distinguish isolated fixtures from
authorized live-account checks; note anything not verified.

## Limits and compatibility

Describe remaining limitations, affected configuration and migration needs.
For external actions, explain any change to review, target identity or recovery.

## Contributor checks

- [ ] I kept credentials, PINs, private messages and runtime state out of the diff.
- [ ] I updated affected documentation and added a regression when behavior changed.
- [ ] I ran relevant checks and `git diff --check`, or explained why a check could not run.
